@Sikozen I was looking around the net today to find a good Sugar Glass recipe for you, as I can't for the life of me find the one I used in the past.

Here are the instructions:

Make the sugar glass. Mix 2 cups water, 1 cup corn syrup, white sugar, and cream of tartar in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Use a candy thermometer and boil sugar syrup until temperature reaches 300 degrees (hard ball), stirring constantly. The mixture will thicken as water evaporates. When sugar reaches 300 degrees, quickly pour onto a metal baking pan - with or without a silpat mat. Cool until completely hardened then break.
